rationale: Quarter revenue growth and annual margin use different currency bases and precisions. A forecast bridge must match thousand-dollar actuals to million-dollar projections without double-removing an included cost or inventing average membership data.
exposure: Reference/control verification only, no candidate-model exposure
reference_method: Independent Python Decimal calculations from source facts, separate from submitted SQL
candidate_view_review: Source headings, signs, periods and relevant definitions directly inspected before model exposure
